correctness.rationale: For centrally symmetric convex K, the exact chord formula w*t-area_loss = 2 int_0^t (h-z_s) ds uses short-chord level sets. At theta=lambda*t^3, the upper support graph rescales to f_lambda(u)=u^4/4+lambda*u and its minimum is -3|lambda|^(4/3)/4. Equal-height endpoints spaced by r give the unique cubic midpoint m^3+(r^2/4)m+lambda=0. Uniform strict-convex localization supports integration of the rescaled support deficit and produces the F integral. The implicit-derivative positivity proves strict monotonicity; expansion of the cubic solution gives -7/480, and axial slicing F(0)=1/160. Independently implemented actual two-dimensional overlap quadrature with all thin endpoint intervals separated agreed with F at lambda=0,0.2,1 as t decreased, and checked F(1)=0.236019362175881.

final_claim: For the planar unit l4 ball K, as t->0 with translation angle theta=lambda*t^3 (lambda fixed and locally uniform), the true perpendicular width times t minus area loss equals t^5 F(lambda)+o(t^5), where F is a precise integral of the unique cubic midpoint root. F is even and strictly increasing on |lambda|, F(0)=1/160 and F(lambda)=|lambda|^(2/3)/4-7/480+O(|lambda|^(-2/3)).
limitations: Planar l4 unit disk only; Euclidean small-translation t; correct perpendicular dual-norm width.
No simultaneous t->0 and |lambda|->infinity theorem, nor arbitrary l_p/dimensional extension.
